alpha_mechanism: A completed, positively executed Binance COIN-M forced-liquidation snapshot is a censored lower-bound observation of vulnerable inventory transfer. A pooled causal model estimates whether the mapped Bybit USDT-linear market reaches frozen upper or lower external liquidity first.

signal_source.semantics: published executed snapshots only; never complete liquidation volume
signal_source.executed_quantity: accumulated_filled_quantity if positive, else last_filled_quantity if positive, else zero
signal_source.notional: executed contract count multiplied by hash-recorded exchangeInfo.contractSize
signal_source.availability: completion of the containing UTC one-minute source bucket plus five seconds

feature_availability: Every market feature ends at the latest minute whose close is available by the source decision timestamp. The future entry open is execution only.

structural_map.pivot_confirmation: two completed bars on each side
structural_map.pools: nearest unconsumed confirmed high above and low below the decision reference within 14 calendar days

model.calibration: one chronological isotonic map when the calibration partition has at least 50 resolved rows and both classes
model.missing_values: training-partition medians; an entirely missing optional feature receives zero

pre2024_chronology.label_rule: No first-passage label crosses a partition boundary

halfyear_update.model_fit: expanding resolved labels ending six months before each half-year cutoff
halfyear_update.calibration: last six completed calendar months before the cutoff
halfyear_update.risk_notional: highest positive 24bp no-liquidation geometric growth on the last completed 12 months
halfyear_update.position_at_update: carried until structural target, stop, or completed state invalidation; never liquidated for elapsed time

action.selection: take only the larger strictly positive action; otherwise flat
action.entry: first executable minute open after the frozen decision timestamp
action.entry_gap: zero gross and full modeled cost, with no favorable reroute

exit: frozen structural stop with adverse opening-gap fill
completed same-symbol state invalidation when the held-side expected edge is no longer positive
funding: actual Binance USD-M funding proxy in the pre-2024 fatal screen; exact Bybit funding required for a survivor

risk_search.selection: highest positive 24bp full-calendar geometric growth among no-liquidation paths; winner-removal growth and lower drawdown are tie-breakers

pre2024_advancement: no forced liquidation, bankruptcy, or terminal NAV loss
survivor_next_stage: unchanged exact Bybit BBO, mark, funding, latency, partial-fill, capacity, margin, liquidation-distance, and continuous-NAV reconstruction, followed immediately by official 2024H1 using the 2023-12-31 cutoff
failure_action: retire this exact information unit without adjacent feature, threshold, target, stop, risk, or leverage rescue
